product.title: Cortech Endurance Locker - One-Piece Rotationally Molded Lockable Property Storage Unit - Model 7300
product.body_html:
The Cortech Endurance Locker, like the rest of Cortech's Endurance Series Furniture line, is ideal for continuous use in extreme environments, including compassionate and normative Behavioral Health Care Facilities, Residential Treatment Centers and Facilities, Hospital Psychiatric Units, Correctional Institutions, Mental Health Treatment Centers and other medical and public safety facilities that require the ultimate combination of durability and functional design.

The Endurance Locker was designed with the security and safety of every individual’s property in mind. The complete plastic design meets the requirements of all property storage systems and ultimately contributes to less maintenance. 

  • Durable, one piece, rotationally molded design for increased strength. Constructed of high impact “no break” polyethylene. No steel or wood components
  • Molded-in shelving for open storage of personal items
  • 7.75 cu. ft. internal storage space
  • Interior contains two non-removable shelves and an anti-ligature shelf for handing clothes
  • Slightly sloped interiors for easy washing and drainage
  • Stain resistant
  • Top shelf for additional storage
  • Stand alone or bolt to the wall via concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice (hardware not included)
  • Sound dampening
  • Passes Flammability UL 94 HB
  • Tested to ISO 22196 showing a >99% reduction in bacteria
  • Flame Retardant (passes Cal 133). Test reports available upon request
  • Available models:
    • 7300 - Locker with door
      • Flush mounted combination lock with center key override
      • Door hinges with molded plastic interior hinging system. NO METAL HINGES
      • Integrated Master Lock grants predetermined combinations to each individual user for increased privacy; however, keys with the ability to override these combinations can be provided upon request
    • 7200 - Locker without door and lock
  • Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Sand, Slate Blue, Stone Gray
  • Made in the USA

About Cortech Endurance Furniture:
The Cortech Endurance intense use furniture line is ideal for use as behavioral health furniture, correctional facility furniture, detention furniture, and Behavioral Healthcare mental health furniture. The Endurance Furniture Series is also a perfect fit for residential institutions, public safety facilities, detention centers, correctional institutions, prisons and any intense or high abuse applications such as drug and alcohol rehabilitation centers and addiction treatment centers.

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
